Privacy, in plain English.

This page covers what we collect, why, and what we'll never do with it. It's short because our data practices are short.

What we collect.

If you request the guide, your email address. If you book a call, your name, email, and whatever you choose to tell us about your situation. Standard website analytics tell us which pages get read, in aggregate, not who you are.

What we do with it.

We use your email to send what you asked for and to reply to you. We use what you tell us about your situation to prepare for your call. We use analytics to figure out which pages are confusing.

What we don't do.

We don't sell your information. We don't share it with third parties for their marketing. We don't add you to a drip campaign because you downloaded one page. If you email us to delete your information, we delete it and confirm.

The necessary specifics.

We use [analytics provider] for site analytics and Calendly and [form provider] to run our booking calendar and forms; each has its own privacy policy. If our practices change, this page changes, and the date below moves with it. Questions: hello@medrepartners.com.
